notes:
This dataset contains multiple-month time series data of various radio technology parameters, such as the Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) value, in combination with soil and environmental data captured by a local sensor. Also take a look at the data from the Froggit DP2000 local weather station, which is placed directly next to our deployment.
Our sensor node pairs were deployed in Potsdam, Germany, near Berlin.

Further information in the README Document and the manuscript.
